name: AI Stow NVGs
scope: Evaluate day/night NVG stow/restore with real inventory capacity, item identity, authored loadouts and current locality. Avoid loss/duplication, inappropriate animation/visibility changes or global all-unit polling when existing CBE discovery can own bounded updates.
identityEvidence: User URL and accessible Workshop description/title; matching installed folder absent; readable source not located by this intake. No extracted-code review or behaviour proof.
evaluationTopics: Trace actual config/FSM/scripts, callers and native writers; compare selected useful intent with current CBE owners before integration.
Record retained/adapted/rejected methods and dependencies/licence/provenance. No implementation credit from title, metadata or file counts.
Preserve mission/Zeus authority, finite owner-local lifecycle, player/specialist ownership and credible animation; avoid extra permanent scanners/controllers.
licence: UNVERIFIED; establish original upstream and component-specific reuse rights before incorporating code.
sourceReview: NOT_STARTED; webpage/local metadata and package inventory only.
ordering: Foundations/FSM first, individual behaviour before squad/combined arms; compatibility expansion last. Reference-only items supply methods rather than an automatic implementation obligation.
sourceProtection: Installed Workshop/game files, original signatures/assets and preserved references are read-only. No execution/repacking or copying raw reference assets into the product. Any future extraction uses a separate private dated directory.
